description_sq:
Penthouse 4+1+2 me verandë në Ali Dem

Salloni i ndenjes është i veçuar, duke ofruar një hapësirë të dedikuar për relaks dhe mikpritje, ndërsa kuzhina është më vete, funksionale dhe praktike. Apartamenti është i pajisur gjithashtu me oxhak, që kri
title_en: Penthouse 4+1+2 with veranda in Ali Dem
description_en: 4+1+2 penthouse with veranda in Ali Dem A rare opportunity to live in a stylish and functional penthouse, positioned in the sought after area of ​​Ali Dem. The apartment has an internal area of ​​160 m² and is ideally organized for maximum comfort. The property consists of 4 bedrooms, where the master bedroom has a private bathroom, guaranteeing privacy and comfort. One of the rooms is equipped with an internal wardrobe, perfect for optimal organization. The distribution corridor harmoniously connects all the premises. The living room is separate, offering a dedicated space for relaxation and hospitality, while the kitchen is separate, functional and practical. The apartment is also equipped with a fireplace
